ModMetaData.name: Between Sus
ModMetaData.author: Nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Impostors and crewmates in RimWorld. Start on a spaceship map, get a secret team and a secret role, and find out who is sus.
Work in progress. First milestone: two teams (Crewmate, Impostor) and two roles (Innocent Crewmate, Impostor).
[url=https://github.com/vbardales/Rimworld-Between-Sus]Source code on GitHub[/url]
